summary: Implemented SHACL path parsing. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier) and SHACLPathError (direct Exception subclass). Added test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with parametrized valid/invalid cases plus a non-node input test. Ran the new tests and test/test_path.py with the generator venv: 40 passed. Nothing committed. Not verified: mypy, black, isort and ruff are not installed in the shared venv, so type-check and formatting were checked by reading only. The non-node guard uses `# type: ignore[unreachable]` on its raise line, which mypy has not confirmed.
